instructions: Complete the sentences below. Choose NO MORE THAN TWO WORDS from the passage for each answer.

items.prompt: The team knew that, if the reading worked, the grains would count among the earliest samples of (19) ........ ever obtained from an archaeological find.
items.evidence: Success would place the wheat among the oldest plant DNA ever recovered and analysed, and would let the researchers compare it precisely with modern wheat species rather than relying on the shape of the grain alone, which can be an unreliable guide to a plant's genetic identity.
items.explanation: Paragraph C says that if the work succeeds, the wheat would rank among the oldest plant DNA ever obtained; so the answer is 'plant DNA'.

items.prompt: While most communities of the period were still small and mobile, the site had grown into a dense, (20) ........ settlement.
items.evidence: What set the site apart was its scale: at a time when most human communities were still small and mobile, Çatalhöyük had grown into a dense, town-like settlement, sitting on routes that would later carry farming practices onward into Europe.
items.explanation: Paragraph A says that at a time when most human communities were still small and mobile, the site had grown into a dense, town-like settlement; so the answer is 'town-like'.

yeniden_uretim.eski_prompt: So that no modern genetic material could reach the ancient samples, the work was split between two (20) ........ , one in Britain and one in Turkey.
yeniden_uretim.eski_kanit_cumlesi: To avoid contaminating the ancient samples with modern DNA, the extraction and analysis were carried out in two physically separate laboratories, one at the University of Manchester in the United Kingdom and the other at Middle East Technical University in Turkey.
yeniden_uretim.neden_elendi: Bosluk 'two ........ , one in Britain and one in Turkey' kalibinin ucundaydi ve eski DNA'nin cikarildigi yer soruldugunda bas ad zorunlu olarak 'laboratories' oluyordu; model uc turda da pasajsiz bu bas adi yazdi. Ayrica kalem, matching-headings 16 ile AYNI kanit cumlesini (D/1) paylasiyordu -- CAPRAZ-KOK'un AC2'ye ait tek kanit cakismasi buydu.
yeniden_uretim.ne_degisti: Bosluk kalibin ucundan kaynagin sectigi nitelemeye tasindi: sorulan sey artik isin nerede yapildigi degil, yerlesimin pasajda nasil tarif edildigi. Kanit A/3'e alindi; boylece D/1 cakismasi kapandi (D/1 yalniz matching-headings 16'ya kaldi) ve 19-22 tamamlama dizisi pasaji bastan sona duzenli yuruyen bir sirada olmaktan cikti. Bosluk 'a dense, ___ settlement' cercevesinde: disaridan urban / permanent / large gibi bircok aday geliyor, dogru sozcuk yalniz pasajdan okunuyor.

items.prompt: The markers designed for the work ran from about 106 to (21) ........ base pairs in length, short enough to pick up badly degraded fragments.
items.evidence: The team focused on a gene responsible for a key wheat protein, designing several sets of short genetic markers, ranging from around 106 to 243 base pairs in length, specifically built to capture the small, degraded fragments of DNA that survive in seeds this old.
items.explanation: Paragraph D says the genetic markers ranged from around 106 to 243 base pairs in length; so the answer is '243'.

yeniden_uretim.eski_prompt: A stretch of genetic material carried only by six-chromosome wheat, known as the (21) ........ , turned up in grains that shape alone had put down as einkorn and emmer.
yeniden_uretim.eski_kanit_cumlesi: From these samples the team recovered thirty-two DNA sequences in total, and among them were fragments containing the so-called D genome, a segment of genetic material found only in hexaploid wheat.
yeniden_uretim.neden_elendi: Cevabin kendisi yerlesik bir bugday genetigi terimi ve cumle onun tanimini veriyor: 'alti kromozomlu bugdaya ozgu genetik bolge' zaten D genome'un tanimidir; model uc turda da yazdi (3/3 PUAN). Tanim cikarilirsa hangi dizinin soruldugu belirsizlesir. Ayrica 3. calistirma ayni pasajda hexaploid terimini tasiyan practice-6'yi da ayni gerekceyle elemisti. E6 onerisi: E/3'un sayisal yarisi - toplam otuz iki DNA dizisi.
yeniden_uretim.ne_degisti: Eski soru E/3'e capaliydi ve cevap yerlesik bir bugday genetigi terimiydi ('D genome'); cumle terimin tanimini veriyordu. Yeni soru E/3'e hic degmiyor: kanit D/2'ye, tasarlanan isaretcilerin uzunluk araligina tasindi. Ust sinir yalniz yontem bolumunden okunur.

items.prompt: Of the seventeen distinct variants found at the first marker length, (22) ........ had never been recorded in any genetic database.
items.evidence: Of the sequences obtained at one marker length, twenty-two in all, seventeen distinct genetic variants emerged, thirteen of which had never before been recorded in any genetic database; a further ten sequences at a second marker length revealed five variants, two of them likewise entirely new.
items.explanation: Paragraph E says seventeen distinct variants emerged at the first marker length, thirteen of which had never before been recorded in any genetic database; so the answer is 'thirteen'.

yeniden_uretim.eski_prompt: By the usual account, the growing of einkorn began in the (22) ........ area in the south of Turkey.
yeniden_uretim.eski_kanit_cumlesi: Simple wheat domestication is usually traced to the Fertile Crescent around twelve thousand years ago, with the region of Karacadağ in southern Turkey generally credited as the birthplace of einkorn cultivation specifically.
yeniden_uretim.neden_elendi: Cevabin kendisi bir ozel ad ve arkeoloji ders kitabi bilgisi: einkorn ekiminin dogdugu yer olarak Karacadag anilir; model uc turda da yazdi (3/3 PUAN). 3. calistirma ayni pasajda ayni ekseni tasiyan AC2-24 ve AC2-25'i zaten elemisti, dolayisiyla bu yuva o kararin devami. 🔴 E6 dikkat: G/2 artik bu testte ucuncu kez elenen bir yuvanin kanit cumlesi; bu cumleye yeni soru yazilmamali. E6 onerisi: G paragrafinin yayilma anlatisi yerine E/3'teki korunma karsilastirmasi.
yeniden_uretim.ne_degisti: Eski soru G/2'ye capaliydi ve cevap bir ozel ad ve arkeoloji ders kitabi bilgisiydi (Karacadag). E5 ayrica G/2'ye yeni soru yazilmamasini ozellikle istemisti. Yeni soru G paragrafina hic degmiyor: kanit E/4'e, veri tabaninda hic kayitli olmayan varyant sayisina tasindi. Sayim calismanin kendi sonucu.
